name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Grape Lemonade
description: Grape Lemonade tastes like the purple drink of your childhood got a sour-candy makeover. Jammy grape flavor comes in rich and sweet before a sharp squeeze of lemonade cuts through, creating a juicy sweet-tart contrast that keeps bouncing between candy-like grape and citrus pucker. Tiny crunchy candies coat the outside, while two soft, chewy gummy layers pack 50mg of hemp-derived Delta-9 THC in each gummy, keeping the center unmistakably Double-Stacked.
